She is friendly with people and enjoys human company. Fluffy is also good with other dogs and has experience socialising with them positively.

Her affectionate and cheerful nature makes her an enjoyable companion to have around the home. She appears eager to interact and bond with those around her.

Fluffy has previously lived with cats. However, it is noted that she may chase cats in the garden if they run, so careful introductions and supervision would still be sensible in a new home.

Inside the home environment, she has already shown that she can coexist with cats. Her playful instincts simply become more noticeable outdoors.

She is considered suitable for homes with children aged eight years and above. As Fluffy is still young and energetic, older children who understand how to behave calmly around dogs would likely suit her best.

A quieter household is preferred because she has come from a chaotic background with significant responsibilities at a very young age. She deserves stability, patience, and time to settle properly.

On walks, Fluffy can currently be a little chaotic on the lead, although work is already being done to improve this. She has been exercised using a long training line and enjoys running freely while showing a good recall response.

Continued positive reinforcement training will help her build confidence and improve her lead manners further. She appears intelligent and willing to learn.

Fluffy also enjoys her food and is happy eating both raw and cooked diets. Her enthusiasm for meals may make ongoing training easier, as food rewards can be used positively.

She is currently located in Billericay, Essex and can be met there for the right home. Fluffy is now looking for a loving family who can offer her the peaceful and caring future she deserves.

name: Rusty
description:
Rusty is one of the 27 dogs rescued last October from a heartbreaking hoarding situation — a place where love, care, and basic safety were missing for far too long.

When he was found, Rusty was in terrible condition. He had been attacked and suffered from severe, open wounds that required urgent and prolonged veterinary care.

He spent weeks at the clinic, where his wounds were cleaned and treated every single day. While this was a difficult time for him physically, it became a turning point in his life.

Thanks to the patience, consistency, and kindness of our incredible vets, Rusty slowly began to learn that human hands can be gentle, and that he is finally safe.

Today, Rusty is still a shy boy — but he has already come such a long way. He now walks on a lead and will come over happily for treats, showing his growing trust and curiosity.

While he isn’t ready for cuddles just yet, he is quietly building confidence every day, and it’s truly beautiful to watch.

Rusty is looking for a special kind of home — one that understands that healing doesn’t happen overnight. He will need a calm, patient environment where he can continue to blossom at his own pace, without pressure or expectations.

A home with another calm, well-balanced dog would help him feel safe and show him the way.

A quieter setting is essential for Rusty — he wouldn’t cope well in a busy or chaotic home or city life. What he needs most is stability, kindness, and someone willing to give him the time he was never given before.

Rusty may not be the dog who runs straight into your arms, but he is the one who will quietly change your life in the most meaningful way. Watching him learn to trust, to feel safe, and to slowly open up is something truly special.

After everything he has been through, Rusty deserves nothing less than a forever home where he can finally just be a dog — safe, loved, and understood.

name: Margot
description:
Margot is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed.

Margot is a nervous and reserved dog initially, especially when meeting new people. When someone enters her kennel she will typically retreat to a safe space and avoid interaction at first.

Once she becomes familiar with the person, she shows that she is a very sweet-natured girl.

Margot is slightly unsure when having her harness put on, but she will tolerate it with gentle reassurance and patience.

Margot is very early in her lead-walking development. Walks slightly behind the handler.

Frequently checks in for reassurance. Can become spooked by loud noises or sudden movements. May spin on the lead when frightened.

However, her confidence is steadily improving with time and experience. Margot is not yet ready for off-site walks, so her exposure to external stimuli (traffic, busy environments, etc.) has been limited so far.

Margot does toilet in her kennel, so she will likely need continued toilet training in a home environment.

Margot’s carers say Margot is a very sweet kind natured little girl but does lack confidence and will need someone patient to build a bond with her. Margot enjoys 1-1 grooming sessions with the staff.

name: Peaches
description:
Peaches is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed.

Peaches is a very friendly, playful dog who can be excitable and a little nervous at times. She enjoys toys and interaction, and has a bright, outgoing personality.

• Excited when someone enters her kennel and likes to try to play.

• Accepts a collar and harness, though she can be a little resistance when putting on the harness. Once on the lead, she is very excitable, pulls, and can be strong. This will need ongoing help and training. She would benefit from dog training classes

• Has lived with and is friendly towards other dogs.

• Playful and sociable, enjoys interaction with other dogs.

• Toilet Training: Has only ever been in a kennel therefore will need to start toilet training from scratch and the new family need to be prepared to work through this and understand it can take time.

• Crate / Kennel Behaviour: Has been destructive on occasion — for example, she and her kennel mate pulled down a board between kennels.

• Separation: Shows no signs of separation anxiety; comfortable left alone overnight.

• Very active and excitable, particularly around new people and on walks.

Peaches is a friendly, playful, and social dog who enjoys interaction with people and other dogs.

She is best suited to a home with children aged 7 or older, and an adopter who can provide consistent training, mental stimulation, and regular exercise to manage her excitable nature.

While she can be slightly nervous, she has a loving personality and is eager to interact with her environment.

name: Marvel
description:
Marvel is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed currently in Cyprus and can travel upon request.

Marvel was found by a man who did not know where to post or who to ask for help regarding this poor boy.

Due to his circumstances, Marvel was kept tied in the man’s yard for six months while he tried to seek help for him.

A lovely lady offered to help and took him to a private kennel, where she has been caring for him.

Marvel is now under our care, and we are trying to find him the best home he deserves after all he has suffered in his short life.

He is a very friendly, energetic, and playful boy, but also very cuddly. He is approximately 1 year old and is very friendly with people and other dogs.

He will be rehomed with an adoption package including vaccination, microchip, blood tests, neutering, and full RBU. A home check applies.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 6 month old female Cane Corso who has come into rescue as her owner has sadly been paralyzed in an accident.

She is a friendly girl who loves cuddles and company and doesn’t like being on her own so will need a home with someone around.

Suzy is a large puppy who will need further training as her brain and body are still developing.

Although Suzy has been good with dogs on walks, she has never lived with another dog and isn’t sure about sharing her humans’ indoors.

So would need a calm male dog and space within the home so introductions can be built up slowly in that environment after successful introductions here at rescue.

Suzy is a big clumsy girl who would chase cats and has no experience of children so an adult home is required.

name: Terry
description:
Terry is a 10-year-old male English Setter. He is a medium-sized dog from the Basque Country who was sadly given up because he was no longer considered useful for hunting. Despite his age, Terry is incredibly active and full of energy.

He proves that age is just a number, as he is always on the move and eager to stay busy. Terry would love a home where he can enjoy regular walks and outdoor activity.

His energetic personality means he would suit adopters who can keep him mentally and physically engaged.

Terry is friendly with other dogs and affectionate with people. He enjoys human company and would benefit from a loving home where he can receive plenty of attention and care. His sociable nature makes him a pleasant and engaging companion.

It is noted that Terry eats very quickly, likely due to not always having reliable access to food in the past. In a new home, he would need to be fed separately from other dogs and may benefit from using a slow feeder bowl.

With time and stability, he can learn that food will always be available to him.

He is suitable to live with children and can be cat tested for the right home. Terry is currently in Spain and transport is available to the UK. He would thrive in a caring home that understands his needs and appreciates his lively personality.

name: Tuna
description:
Tuna is a medium-large sized Griffon cross and she is 7 years old.

Tuna arrived in the UK from Spain on Saturday 28 March 2026. She is 7 years old (DOB 30/1/2019). Tuna is 57cm high, 97cm long, 22kg.

Tuna is in good health and has previously lived in a home in Spain. She had a lump removed from her leg before she travelled which was benign.

Tuna came to me as a foster on Sat 28th March and has been the perfect house guest. She settled in really quickly and is very calm in the house.

She gets on well with both my dog and x2 cats. She is clean in the house standing by the back door to go out and have a pee. We crated her the 1st night but now she is left out at night as just settles quietly on a bed and sleeps all night.

We have left her for short periods during the day (3 hours ) and again she just goes to sleep when we leave the house. She is good with her food, eating at a normal pace and is not food possessive, but is fed separately from my dog.

When given a treat she goes off somewhere quietly to eat it.

She is walked on a harness but is very strong and does pull and has a very strong hunting drive if a scent or sight of a deer or squirrel is seen where she barks and just wants to get to it.

When this happens I pop a figure of 8 halti on her and this gives much more control and enables her to calm down. But she is very strong and you will need to be well attached to her so she does not pull off from you.

On a road walk again she is walked on a halti and is very well behaved, not spooked by anything at all.

She has ZERO recall and is not receptive to her name at all when out so she must be kept on a lead otherwise she will be long gone.

We have not had the chance to go to a dog park yet but she does like a good coffee shop especially if there is a pupachino on offer.

We have met lots of dogs on our walks and to be honest she is indifferent to them not going out of her way to say hello or interact with them but is fine if they come up to her.

She absolutely loves being cuddled and will sit with her head on your knee wanting love and will paw you when you stop wanting more.

She really is a lovely, kind and gentle dog and will make someone a very special pet.

name: Mikey
description:
Mikey is an 12month old male Bodegero located in Spain.

This very handsome little lad is Mikey, a young Bodegero (Jack Russel type) boy about 18 months old, with a mainly white, smooth, short coat and black and brown markings on his head.

Mikey is super friendly and very loving and affectionate, he will be neutered tomorrow along with his vaccinations, passports and blood tests.

Mikey gets on well with other dogs and walks well on the lead. Poor boy was sadly found abandoned with 2 other dogs by a river bed.

We are looking for a home with or without another dog and children over 8 years old. Mikey hasn’t been tested for cats yet.Great with people and other dogs, a real character. Very good on lead healthy and has such wonderful, gentle nature.

name: Bello
description:
Bello is a 2-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is described as a gentle little boy with a wonderful character, making him a lovely companion for the right home. His calm and kind nature suggests he would settle well into a caring environment.

He is suitable to live with other dogs, showing that he is social and comfortable around canine companions. However, he is not suitable to live with cats, so a cat-free home will be necessary.

This helps ensure that he can live happily without added stress or conflict.

Bello would do well in a home with older children, indicating that he is best suited to a household where interactions are more predictable and considerate.

His gentle personality makes him a good match for families or individuals who can provide patience and affection. He appears to be a well-balanced dog who enjoys companionship and attention.

His willingness to travel expands his chances of finding a suitable family.

Bello will be rehomed with a full adoption package, ensuring his health and wellbeing are prioritised. This includes being vaccinated, microchipped, blood tested, neutered, and having full RBU.

These preparations mean he is ready to transition smoothly into his new home.

A home check will be required as part of the adoption process, ensuring that Bello is placed in a safe and appropriate setting. Interested adopters are encouraged to make contact and express their interest.

He is ready to find a family who will appreciate his gentle nature and give him the care he deserves.

name: Eve
description:
Eve is a 2 year old female samoyed breed. She is medium to large size at around 17kg. She is currently in Croatia.

Eve is a playful dog. She loves people and likes to play with other dogs. She is very cuddly. She is not fully house trained but has learned to walk on a lead.

She needs a firm hand so that she doesn’t pull on the lead.

She is good with other dogs and can live with children who are over 8 years old. She has not been cat tested, but this can be arranged.

Eve is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, infectious diseases two times vaccinated.

Bordatella vaccine will be recieved before transport, castrated, Mediterranean diseases tested-negative Brucellosis tested negative, and Kennel cough nasel given before travel.

Adoption fee and home check applies, and full rescue backup is provided by Ninas Haven.

name: Catarella
description:
Catarella is a 1 year old male Breton Cross.

Catarella came to us from the municipal pound — an ex-hunting dog who was never reclaimed. Since arriving, he’s shown himself to be exactly what you’d expect from a young Breton type: active, social, and very people-focused.

Catarella is full of energy and enjoys running, playing with toys, and interacting with other dogs.

He’s friendly with everyone he meets, including the volunteers’ children, although due to his enthusiasm and tendency to play physically, we’re looking for a home with older children or teenagers.

Affectionate and enjoys human contactGood with other dogs, though can be intense in his approachPlayful and highly activeConfident, with no obvious signs of trauma

Like many ex-hunting dogs, Cat hasn’t had the best start. As with many dogs from a similar background, food hasn’t always been guaranteed.

He’s therefore very food-motivated and will eat quickly and as much as he can, so he’ll need sensible feeding routines and management to keep him healthy and happy.

He also has a high prey drive, so he would not suitable for a home with birds or small furries.

On lead and recall are both coming along, but Cat would benefit from continued training. He travels reasonably well and handles routine situations like the vet without issue.

An active home that can meet his exercise needsOwners willing to continue basic training and provide structureEither as an only dog (with regular social contact) or with a calm femaleHe’s not a difficult dog at all (he is a fabulous, friendly and kind boy), but he’s not low-maintenance. He needs outlets for his energy and a home that understands the needs of a working breed.

Catarella is currently at our shelter in Cordoba in southern Spain but will be coming to a UK foster home soon.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella canis.

All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised. Catarella is neutered.

Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Theo
description:
Little Theo is looking for his forever home

• Breton Cross, 1 year old• Height: 49 cm | Weight: approx 15 kg• Sweet, affectionate, and people-focused• Playful, energetic, and full of personality• Great with other dogs and integrates well• Crate-trained and settling well at home• Making excellent progress with toilet training• Can be left for short periods• Still learning boundaries and managing excitement

Little Theo is the kind of dog who sneaks into your heart before you even realise it. Sweet, affectionate, and completely people-focused, he absolutely loves being around humans -whether that’s playtime, cuddle time, or just quietly relaxing by your side.

Theo is a 1 year old Breton Cross with a height of 49 cm and weighs approximately 15 kg.

Theo is a confident and curious boy who has come on an incredible journey. Once a little flighty and unsure, Theo is now much calmer, softer, and learning how to settle beautifully into home life. He still has his playful, energetic spark (expect some joyful zoomies!), but he’s learning quickly and responds really well to gentle guidance.

Theo is very sociable with other dogs – playful, submissive, and happy in a pack – but he’s just as content doing his own thing too. He’s affectionate in the loveliest way: a burst of excitement followed by calm, snuggly closeness.

Theo is already making great progress with his training – he’s crate-trained, sleeps through the night, and is learning his toilet routine well.

Like any young dog, he’ll need continued support with boundaries (especially around food – he’s a cheeky counter surfer!) and managing his excitement, but his willingness to learn makes him a joy to work with.

Theo would thrive in a home that can continue to guide him, enjoy his playful nature, and give him the love and structure he deserves. In return, you’ll get a loyal, loving companion who just wants to be part of your world.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella Canis.

All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised. Little Theo is neutered. Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Gemma
description:
Gemma is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed who was rescued from a dog pound last June along with three other dogs who are now in loving homes.

Gemma weighs 20 kg and is full of life and energy. She is very intelligent and learns very quickly.

She has had basic training and knows basic commands and, with further training, will make a fantastic companion.

Gemma is a strong, high-energy girl with a confident and independent nature. She is very loving and gets on well with calm dogs, both male and female.

We are looking for an experienced adopter who can give this beautiful girl the time, patience and structure she needs to ensure that she can be the best dog she can be.

The rewards will come in the shape of endless love, loyalty and companionship.

Gemma can travel to the UK as soon as a home is offered.

name: Frankie
description:
Frankie is a 2-year-7-month-old male Jack Russell Terrier. He was found abandoned and had a clear indentation on his neck showing he had previously been chained. He was also underfed, which made his rescue all the more important.

Despite his difficult past, Frankie is described as a pocket rocket with a heart of gold. He is neutered, fully vaccinated, and full of life and enthusiasm. His energetic nature makes him a brilliant running buddy for an active owner.

Frankie absolutely adores people and loves being around his humans. He is especially fond of attention and thrives on companionship. He is the kind of dog who lights up when he is included in daily life.

He can live with children over 12 years of age, which suits his lively and playful personality. His energy means he would do well with older children who understand how to interact respectfully with dogs.

He forms strong bonds and enjoys being part of the family.

When it comes to other dogs, Frankie could possibly live with the right match. He tends to do best with younger, spayed females who can keep up with his playful energy. Careful introductions and sensible management would be important.

Frankie is house trained, which will help him settle into a new home more easily. He can be very enthusiastic at mealtimes and tends to devour his food quickly. Because of this, it is recommended that he is fed separately from other dogs.

His recall is very good in quiet areas, showing he is responsive and engaged with his handler. However, cars and busy environments can distract him, so he will need continued guidance in more stimulating places.

Ongoing training will help him build focus and confidence.

Frankie has survived a rough start in life but has not lost his spark or loving nature. He is loyal, affectionate, and ready for someone who will truly commit to him. He is currently in Cyprus and can fly to the UK in March if the right home is offered.

name: Kaira
description:
Kaira is a 4 year old female Shepherd Cross.

This stunning Shepherd cross is looking for a forever home! At 35 kg, Kaira is a big, confident and playful girl who adores people and enjoys her walks.

She’s curious, interactive, and thrives on attention—perfect for someone who wants a loyal companion by their side.

Despite having a hard life, being abandoned and having been in shelter for most of her life, just look at that smile! Kaira is great on the lead and responds beautifully to basic commands like sit, down, paw and heel!

Sadly dogs like Kaira has been continually overlooked for adoption due to her size but she is just the most beautiful kind soul who will cuddle and play all day – she literally just wants someone to hold her paw and love her!

She would love a home with a secure garden where she can stretch her legs and enjoy the fresh air.

She is selective with other dogs, so she’d prefer to be your one and only, soaking up all the love!

She will be an absolutely fantastic, loving and loyal best friend and whoever adopts Kaira will truly be rescuing a dog who deserves a chance to live the life that every dog deserves.

name: Jerry
description:
Welcome Jerry, a 2 year old male Miniature Pinscher Cross-Breed.

Jerry was rescued last year along with a female and her pups, who are now all adopted. Jerry was not the father of the pups, but he was always with her.

Poor Jerry was in really bad condition and it was obvious he had Leishmania. This has been treated and he now only has to take a very cheap tablet twice a day, which he does without any problem at all.

The Jerry we see today is a very different Jerry to the one we rescued.

This is what his amazing foster mum says about Jerry.

Jerry is the size and shape of a Miniature Pinscher and has the features of one too. He has some cute little flecks of white in his fur, which make him look a lot older, but he is actually only about 2 years old.

Jerry is the happiest little boy; his tail literally never stops wagging. He is extremely affectionate and loves cuddles. He really is the most gentle, loving dog. He loves nothing better than snuggling on your lap or next to you on the sofa.

Jerry is currently being fostered in a home with six other dogs. He gets on very well and plays beautifully with them. He is energetic and playful, and is very intelligent. He loves his toys and teddy bear.

He can be a little bit reactive to cats and it may be best for him to be homed somewhere without cats.

Jerry is house trained, toilet trained, and can sit on command and always comes when he is called. He has the typical Miniature Pinscher stubbornness and boldness, and it is much more effective to use positive-only training methods with him.

I know typically this breed is known for sometimes being a bit nippy, but not Jerry. I have never once seen him show any signs of aggression.

He can be a little bit frightened and barky when he meets new people, but it only takes him about 10 seconds and, as soon as he realizes they are friends, he becomes the sweetest, most loving boy. Everybody who meets him falls in love with him.

He is good with children. Jerry would love to snuggle in bed with you, but also happily sleeps in his own bed, either in your room or downstairs on his own. As long as he has somewhere warm and comfortable, he is happy.

The Leishmania should not put potential adopters off homing this amazing boy. He has been given an otherwise clean bill of health and he will make the most amazing family pet.

Jerry can fly to the UK as soon as a home is offered.

name: Missy
description:
Missy is a tiny 2-year-old Chihuahua cross who deserves so much better than the hand life has dealt her.

She was dumped by her own owner in a neighbouring village, along with another dog. Perhaps they thought that if they left them somewhere unfamiliar, the dogs wouldn’t find their way home.

Sadly, Missy was left to fend for herself by the very person who should have cared for her.

But despite her past, this little girl has plenty of love to give.

Missy is a cuddly, gentle and kind little girl. She loves a cosy, soft bed and never says no to a tasty meal! Missy is protective of her food and may growl at the other dogs coming close to her bowl.

For this same reason, we’re looking for an adult-only home where she can eat her food in peace.

She gets along well with other dogs but is quite happy doing her own thing, so she wouldn’t mind being the only dog in the home.

She is peaceful around cats and could live with a feline companion.

Missy isn’t asking for much – just a warm bed, a full tummy, gentle affection and someone who will never abandon her again. She deserves a home where she’ll always be safe, cherished and wanted.

Missy comes spayed, fully vaccinated, health checked, and with an EU passport.

She is in Hungary, ready to travel once the right home is found for her.

name: Hugo
description:
Hugo is a 2.5 year old male Vizsla Cross. He is as sweet as he is handsome! He is currently located in Cyprus and is ready to fly to the UK once he is adopted.

Hugo is a boy with a lovely character and full of enthusiasm. Hugo was found wandering in a village for weeks begging for someone to take him home.

Hugo is an affectionate and loving boy. From the beginning, Hugo was a very shy dog, but his nervousness was not redirected into reactivity and/or aggression.

Most likely his fearful behavior was a result of bad treatment in the past.

Now he loves to be hugged and stroked by the volunteers at the shelter so with just a bit of patience and a lot of love he can become the most loving doggy.

He’s intelligent and will thrive with ongoing training while he learns the house rules.

Hugo has high levels of energy, as any Vizsla does:) and he will enjoy his walks, exercise and play with other friendly doggie.

Hugo would be best suited to life with a family or as the best mate to someone who has an active lifestyle and likes adventure.

Hugo is very happy to meet other dogs and can be very playful with them so it would be nice for him to be rehomed with another playful friendly doggy.

However, he would also be good as an only dog as long as he spends enough time with his humans.

Hugo will need a lovely secure garden where he can play and chase a ball.

name: Otto
description:
Otto is a handsome seven year old Beagle who originally came from Cyprus and was adopted amid the pandemic. He spent a while in foster with our Head of Adoptions, Eve, before travelling to the UK to meet his new family.

Sadly, he is now seeking a new home due to the arrival of a new baby, which has disrupted the calm environment he was used to.

Otto is an affectionate, cheeky and characterful boy who has been a much loved member of his family for several years. He absolutely loves people and is happiest when he’s receiving plenty of fuss.

He enjoys curling up on the sofa for cuddles, sneaking onto a comfortable bed and finding the warmest spot in the house for an afternoon nap.

He’s a particular fan of sunshine, radiators and heated floors – you can take the dog out of Cyprus and all that! He hates the cold and the rain, and will always sidestep a puddle, and he’s also not a fan of loud noises, motorbikes, or fireworks.

He’s a funny little character with plenty of personality and a love of relaxation and home comforts.

When he’s not enjoying a cosy afternoon indoors, Otto loves getting out and exploring. He’s an adventurous boy who enjoys long walks, trips to cafés and pubs, car journeys and even lengthy hikes.

As a typical Beagle, his nose is often glued to the ground and he loves investigating interesting scents. He walks well on the lead, but his recall is less reliable in open countryside.

Otto is generally very sociable with people and other dogs. He enjoys meeting his canine friends in the park and has happily spent holidays alongside other family dogs.

He could potentially live with another calm, compatible dog, although he can occasionally be uncomfortable around larger entire males.

He’s also comfortable with visitors, even if he likes to announce their arrival with a bark! Otto knows his basic commands, is housetrained and is very responsive to training, especially when tasty treats are involved.

One area where Otto needs understanding and guidance is his tendency to become possessive over toys. He enjoys collecting things and can become defensive if someone tries to take them away.

His family have found that exchanging items for treats works well, but this is something his new adopters will need to manage carefully.

Otto would love a home with people who enjoy being outdoors but are equally happy to spend a relaxed afternoon together.

He has lots of affection to give and would thrive with an adopter who can offer him companionship, enjoyable walks and consistent boundaries around his toys.

His family adore him and have not made the decision to rehome him lightly, but they know that a quieter home without young children will allow him to feel more comfortable.

We know just how much Otto has so much to offer as a funny, affectionate and adventurous companion, and he will happily fill his days with sniffing, exploring and finding the perfect place to curl up beside his favourite people.

name: Fivos
description:
Fivos is a 5 years old male Husky cross of approximately 25kgs and is currently in foster care in Norwich.

Fivos was found as a stray in Cyprus and lived for about 2 years in a shelter, with no chance of being adopted in Cyprus we flew him to the UK.

Fivos has thrived since his arrival, he appreciates home comforts and enjoys playing with toys.

He travels well in a car, is housetrained and can be left for a couple of hours on his own. Walks and adventures are a must for Fivos, he is good with meeting other dogs of any size as long as introductions are managed.

He meets dogs every day on his walks and enjoys the company. Fivos is a typical husky and has a stubborn streak, but he does understand the word ‘No’.

In seeking his forever home Fivos needs a big breed experienced owner, someone who will continue with his training and become his pack leader.

His owner(s) will be outdoor active people. Whilst Fivos has shared a home with another dog we would recommend that he be adopted as an only dog.

Fivos can live with older children but have not been cat tested.

With the right family, Fivos has the potential to become the most amazing, loyal and affectionate friend and companion.

name: Amos
description:
Amos is a 15 month old male Hound Cross. This stunning boy was rescued from the municipal pound a few months ago, where he was a bag of bones, very frightened and withdrawn.

With patience, kindness and lots of loving reassurance from the kennel team, Amos is no longer the scared, timid boy he was when he first arrived and is now back to a healthy weight for his breed at around 20 kilograms.

He is currently living with other dogs and has no issues. He loves to run and play with his kennel buddies. He walks well on a lead and enjoys interacting with the kennel volunteers.

Amos is ready for his forever home and would suit an active household with a secure garden where he can run, play and sniff with that hound nose.

The next freedom flight is in March and everyone would love Amos to be one of the lucky ones flying to his forever home.

name: Logan
description:
Logan is 4 years old thought to be a Rhodesian Ridgeback cross; at 30-40kg. Logan is more of a BFG than a cute puppy, but he still didn’t deserve to be tied to a tree and left to die, with no food or water.

Thankfully he was found in time and taken into care. Currently in Cyprus, Logan just needs that very special family; it could be you!

Logan is a big beautiful ginger and white boy who sometimes forgets that he’s all grown up, his exuberance knows no bounds. Sometimes has the odd mishap with his body as he forgets where his limbs are!

His beautiful long legs sometimes forget to stop in time, he occasionally bumps into things or sends things flying as he charges round doing his happy dance with a silly smile on his face. Underneath that goofy exterior lies a pure heart of gold, so trusting and good with people despite his awful early experiences.

He is so friendly, soft and gentle despite his size and thoroughly enjoys being touched; he seeks out physical contact and lots of love and just adores the interaction with people. He loves lots of praise as well and responds in such a loving manner.

Whilst Logan still has a few manners to polish (such as pulling on the lead) he is very food motivated, which makes training games much easier. He doesn’t show any signs of resource guarding or problems with other dogs, but size wise one Logan per household would probably be enough!

We don’t yet know if he can be left alone without his special people, so ideally someone who could spend a lot of time with him or works from home might suit him best.

Please help us get Logan out of the shelter, it is not the best place for any dog, never mind a large gorgeous boy who needs lots of mental and physical stimulation. He needs games, long walks, some running but most importantly, Logan needs YOU. He has already been in the shelter for over 2 years after being found and rescued.

He really deserves a (large!) comfy sofa, not a hard concrete floor. If you can offer a special place in your heart for Logan you will not be disappointed, turning this gentle loving boy from an abandoned dog into a valued and much loved family member will be hugely rewarding.

Logan can pack his bags at a moments notice if the right family were to be found; he is ready when you are!

name: Lucky
description:
Lucky spent 3.5 years in a shelter and has been in his foster home in Cyprus for the last six months.

He has a strong mind and will require someone who respects him and his boundaries. While he’s a bit picky with some men and dogs (mainly bigger male dogs), his love for children knows no bounds.

He shines when he’s the centre of attention, making him the perfect match for a home where he can be the only pet, soaking up all the affection.

He’s just the right size for any family and absolutely adores those he forms bonds with. Gaining your trust is the key to his heart and affection.

He is extremely loving with people but doesn’t like to be picked up unless he is prepared and ready. He enjoys stroking, belly rubs, and rough play but has his limits.

If he doesn’t like something, he will let you know. His past trauma still lingers, and sometimes elements of his earlier life abuse remain evident.

Lucky is fully housetrained, walks extremely well on the leash, and really enjoys his walks. He loves to sleep on the bed but is also happy to sleep in his own bed once he gets his five minutes of affection.

He is a clever boy who learns easily and follows routines well.

With other dogs, Lucky absolutely loves playing with female dogs of similar size. In general, he is much better with females but appears afraid of dogs that are much bigger than him, which can be seen as reactivity towards some male dogs outside.

An experienced adopter is needed—someone who understands rescues and the challenges they may bring, and who will set boundaries while also respecting Lucky’s own boundaries.

A home with a secure and safe garden in a quiet, rural setting would be ideal, where Lucky can take leisurely walks in peace. He needs a quiet home with children aged 15+, where he can receive affection on his own terms.

Lucky will happily jump up and join you on the sofa and enjoys being close to those he trusts and loves.

Lucky is fully vaccinated, has had blood tests, is neutered, Brucella Canis tested, and is ready to fly once adopted.

name: Dana
description:
Dana is a 5 year old female Cross-Breed currently in Kent and looking for her forever home after spending much of her early life in kennel environments before moving into a UK foster home in 2024.

Since arriving in foster care, Dana has begun to show real progress and her confidence has grown steadily as she learns what it feels like to live in a stable home environment. Day by day, her personality has started to shine through more clearly.

Dana is an affectionate and gentle dog who enjoys close contact with people she trusts. She loves cuddles, will happily settle beside you on the sofa, and enjoys quiet companionship as well as time spent relaxing in the sun.

She also has a playful side and enjoys interacting with other friendly dogs.

She can be unsure of new situations and may find some everyday experiences a little overwhelming at times, particularly things she has not encountered before. With patience and gentle guidance, she is eager to learn and responds well to calm, positive support.

Dana can also be initially wary of men, but once she builds trust, she forms strong attachments and becomes very loving and loyal to her people.

She could live with other friendly dogs and would likely benefit from having a calm canine companion in the home. She is best suited to a home with older, dog-savvy children who understand when to give her space and allow her to settle.

Dana will thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace. She will need ongoing gentle training, reassurance, and stability as she continues to adjust to home life after her early experiences.

She is now ready for a committed family who can offer her the time, understanding, and love she needs to continue her journey and finally enjoy the security of a forever home.

When contacting us, please include a phone number or a non-iCloud email address, as iCloud emails are currently bouncing and we cannot contact applicants using them.

All dogs rehomed via this rescue will be vaccinated, neutered/spayed, and microchipped. Home checks apply, and full post-adoption support is offered.

name: Bam Bam
description:
BAM BAM is a 9-month-old male Chow Chow Cross. He is a friendly, social young dog who weighs around 25 kg and enjoys spending time with people. He is affectionate and has a happy nature despite having a difficult start in life.

He gets along well with other dogs and is also good with children over the age of 10. His compatibility with cats is not mentioned, so this would need to be assessed in his new home.

BAM BAM would thrive in a family that can give him plenty of attention and companionship.

Before his rescue, BAM BAM was kept in a very small enclosure with pigs and chickens. His previous owner claimed that he had gone after the chickens, but since being rescued and spending time around them, he has shown no interest in harming them. This suggests that he has settled well into a more positive environment.

Despite the neglect he experienced, BAM BAM has remained loving, affectionate and eager to be around people. He enjoys human company and is looking for a family who will provide him with the love, care and security that he deserves.

A home where someone has plenty of time to spend with him would suit him best.

BAM BAM has been neutered and is vaccinated. His Brucellosis test will be sent to the UK before he travels. His adoption fee is £525, a home check is required, and rescue back-up will be provided following his adoption.

name: Floki
description:
I’m a 5 year old medium size cross breed boy.

For 3.5 years, I’ve been living in a shelter in Hungary, that’s more than half my life spent waiting behind a fence, hoping someone might stop… might notice me… might choose me. But no one ever has. Sometimes I feel invisible. I’m only 5 years old.

I’m not loud or demanding. I’m patient and quiet. I’m the kind of dog who waits in silence and hopes that one day someone will see the good boy I truly am and will not walk past me.

I love my walks, and I walk beautifully on the lead. I enjoy sniffing the world and feeling the sun on my back. I love hoomans—every scratch behind the ears and every cuddle means the world to me, because I get so little affection here.

But I treasure every moment. I never take kindness for granted.

I’m calm and peaceful around other dogs. I don’t want trouble; I just want love.

And although my muzzle is beginning to grey, please don’t think I’m old. I’m still young, playful in my soft and gentle way, and I dream—every single day—of having a home, a bed of my own, and a family who finally calls me theirs.

I have spent so long waiting, but I haven’t given up.I still believe my person is out there.

If you’re reading this… maybe it’s you.Maybe you’re the one who will make sure I’m invisible no more.

Floki is ready to travel from Hungary once the right family is found.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU passport.

name: Connie
description:
Connie is a 2 year old female Puli Cross. Her story began in a public pound, where she grew up in harsh conditions. A year ago, she was rescued in a heartbreaking state – skin and bone, frightened and frail.

With care, love, and patience, Connie has blossomed into a happy, affectionate girl. Today she’s full of life – her waggy tail never stops, she adores treats and cuddles, and she has even learned to smile when she’s with the people she loves. This beautiful girl has learned to trust again!

Connie loves the company of other dogs and is especially playful – wrestling and mingling are her favourite games! She would be just as happy snuggling up on the sofa as she is joining in on adventures.

Connie is still waiting in a small shelter in Hungary, dreaming of her forever family. She deserves a home where she will be cherished, spoiled, and loved for the sweet, resilient girl she is.

For Connie, an experienced rescue dog home would be ideal – someone patient and understanding, ready to continue guiding her on her journey.

She could live happily with another friendly and playful dog or as the only dog in the home.

2 years oldPlayful, affectionate, sociableSpayed, vaccinated, microchipped, with EU passportCan travel to the UK once her family is found

If you can give Connie the love-filled home she has been waiting for, please get in touch.

Adoption subject to home check & fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Gesztenye
description:
Gesztenye is a beautiful 2-year-old medium-sized brindle girl with the sweetest soul. She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and greets everyone she meets with a wagging tail and a hopeful smile.

For over two years, Gesztenye and her sister Zserbo have shared everything. They were rescued together from a kill shelter when they were only a few weeks old. They grew up side by side, slept in the same kennel, and waited together for someone to finally choose them.

Now Zserbo’s dream has come true. She has found a wonderful family in the UK.

But little Gesztenye will soon watch her sister leave… and for the first time in her life, she will be alone.

She has so much love to give and asks for so little in return – just a family to call her own.

Gesztenye is friendly with dogs and would happily live with another canine companion. She is affectionate, playful and kind natured, and can also live with older dog-savvy children.

She’s looking for a home where she will be part of family life and not left alone for long periods.

Like all rescue dogs, Gesztenye will need time, patience and love, but in return she will give you her whole heart.

Gesztenye is currently in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as her forever family finds her.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, comes with and EU pet passport.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is an adorable 11-month-old small mixed breed girl looking for a loving forever home. She and her three siblings were found abandoned as tiny puppies, all in very poor condition, frightened and unsure of the world around them.

With their parents unknown and their future uncertain, all they had was each other.

Thankfully, Cleo has blossomed into a wonderful young dog. Although naturally a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, she is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate once she feels safe.

Her confidence continues to grow every day.

She loves playing with other dogs and enjoys spending time with people she knows and trusts. Cleo would thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace.

In return, she will reward her family with unwavering loyalty and love.

Cleo could happily live with another friendly well-balanced dog and she has all the potential to live with cats, too.

As a small-sized girl, Cleo would make a lovely companion for someone looking for a gentle, kind-hearted dog.

She comes spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated and with an EU pet passport.

name: Apollo
description:
Meet Apollo – a gentle soul ready for a new life.

Apollo, a 3.5-year-old medium size cross-breed boy, whose life until now has been far from kind, has finally been freed from a life lived on a chain. Yet somehow, despite everything, he has held onto his sweetness, his trust, and his huge heart.

Apollo is incredibly human-centred, affectionate, and loving — the kind of dog who just wants to be close to people and soak up kindness.

He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Ariel
description:
Ariel is a 6-year-old small-medium sized girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This feisty little terrier has been waiting in the shelter for over 3 years… far longer than any dog should have to wait.

Ariel is full of character – a true terrier spirit. She’s lively, expressive and not afraid to let you know when she’s excited – it’s all part of her charm!

She is affectionate with people and loves children, happily soaking up attention and enjoying being part of the action. Ariel forms lovely bonds and will be a loyal and loving companion to her family.

With other dogs, she is friendly with most and enjoys their company, though like many terriers, she appreciates respectful introductions and a good match in energy.

After spending such a long time in the shelter, Ariel truly deserves a home where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be loved every day.

She would love a family who will embrace her fun personality, include her in their lives, and give her the attention she’s been missing for so long.

Ariel is in Hungary, ready to travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Paddy
description:
Paddy is a 9 year old male medium cross-breed currently in Scotland.

He is neutered and settled into home life following rescue from a shelter environment.

Paddy is affectionate, calm and people-focused once he has built trust. He forms strong bonds with his primary carers and enjoys close companionship, but can be wary of unfamiliar people. Slow and controlled introductions are recommended.

He prefers a quiet environment and can become overwhelmed in busy households or where there are frequent visitors.

Paddy is housetrained, can be left alone and walks well on lead. He enjoys regular walks and time outdoors, although he can be sensitive to traffic and may require reassurance around vehicles.

He travels well once in the car but may need assistance getting in. He is comfortable with routine handling and enjoys grooming.

Paddy can live with other calm and respectful dogs, although he prefers his own space for resting. He may also be able to live with a cat following careful introductions.

He would suit a quiet, adult-only home in a rural or semi-rural location. An experienced adopter who can provide a calm, structured environment and allow him time to build trust would be ideal.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a beautiful, smaller-medium-sized 2 year old Cross-Breed girl who may be a little shy when meeting new people, but give her some time and patience, and she’ll have the chance to show you what a lovely companion she can be.

She gets on brilliantly with other dogs and could happily share her home with canine friends. She could also live with older children who understand that some dogs need a little time to feel comfortable.

We can also cat test her if needed for the right applicant.

Maggie’s story began in difficult circumstances. She and her six siblings were born in an abandoned property, where their emaciated mum struggled to feed her puppies.

The little family was taken in by the local shelter when the pups were just three weeks old.

All seven puppies were stunningly beautiful, but heartbreakingly, two are still waiting for their forever families. Maggie is now two years old, and it’s time her own happy ending began.

Maggie’s spayed, fully vaccinated and ready to travel once the right family is found.

Home check and adoption fee apply. Full RBU provided.

name: Perine
description:
Perine is an 11 month old female small cross-breed currently in the East Midlands.

She is spayed, iElisa negative and weighs approximately 9kg.

Perine is a confident and outgoing young dog who enjoys being involved in day-to-day activities. She is playful, inquisitive and affectionate with people once settled.

She is friendly with men and women and has been positive around children. Due to her excitable nature, she would be best suited to a home with older children.

Perine gets along well with other dogs and benefits from their presence. A calm resident dog would help support her development and confidence.

She can be vocal when greeting visitors but settles quickly and seeks interaction.

Perine is still in the early stages of training. She may mouth during play and will require continued training and guidance as she matures.

She is housetrained, sleeps well overnight and accepts a lead, although she will benefit from ongoing lead training to build consistency and confidence.

Perine is used to a quieter environment and may find busy or high-traffic areas overwhelming.

Perine would suit a home able to provide structure, routine and ongoing training. A secure garden and a patient, active household will support her continued development.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Mary
description:
Mary is a 3.5 year old female German Shepherd Cross. Originally from Romania, Mary was found all alone when tiny and taken to a private shelter where she was very lonely.

Mary spent three years there before she came to foster with a vet in Newmarket, Suffolk.

Mary has blossomed; she loves life and all she wants to do is shake hands with you. She can be a bit nervous when she meets someone new, but once she knows there is nothing to worry about, she is fine.

She is so friendly, affectionate, and loves cuddles. Mary is kind and calm but also enjoys a good run in a safe area. She is good on the lead and weighs 26 kg.

Mary is just a very special girl. She is looking for a home with someone who has plenty of time for her and can offer her an active life.

She is good with dogs, cats, and hens. She loves the car and will hop in and out with no problem. No children are preferred so she can be the centre of your world.

Mary has a lopsided face, possibly born like that, but it cannot be confirmed. It makes her all the more endearing. She is in foster with a vet who has given her a clean bill of health.

Mary is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has a passport. You will not find a nicer dog than Mary.

Adoption fee £500. A home check is required, and there is rescue backup. Please consider this absolutely delightful girl.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.

A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Tango
description:
Tango is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. He was saved from the streets with his 4 siblings and their mum, who is a Dachshund cross.

Tango is a very kind-natured boy—friendly, affectionate, and playful. He has a beautiful, friendly look and a well-proportioned build. He loves people and enjoys a lively, playful lifestyle.

He is very social with his doggie mates and plays well with them.

Tango would be best suited for a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and is treated as a family member. He would love to go on nice adventures! He will need time to settle into his new home, and his training will need to be continued.

He could live happily with another friendly, playful dog or as the only dog in the home, being the centre of attention.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog. Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tango is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Damian
description:
Meet Damian, a young cross-breed dog with a gentle soul who is slowly learning to trust the world around him.

Damian is around 2 years old and was rescued from another shelter after being found wandering alone on a road, likely having been abandoned. His early life was not kind to him, and he arrived shy and fearful, unsure of people and new experiences.

Despite this, Damian is making steady progress. With patience and care from the team at Rescates Garatuxa in northern Spain, he is beginning to come out of his shell.

Recently, he took an important step forward by going for a walk outside on a harness with a volunteer – a big milestone for a dog like him.

We believe Damian did not receive proper nutrition or care as a puppy, which has affected his physical development. This is sadly not uncommon in hunting dogs.

What he needs now is a home that can offer him time, understanding, and gentle guidance as he continues to build confidence.

Damian is good with other dogs and would likely benefit from a calm, stable environment, possibly with another confident dog to help him feel secure. He would suit an experienced and patient adopter who understands that trust takes time.

He will be fully prepared for travel – vaccinated, microchipped, neutered, and with his passport ready – and can travel to the U.K. or across Europe to the right home.

If you can offer Damian the quiet, compassionate home he needs, you will see him slowly blossom into a loyal and loving companion.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up.

name: Malna
description:
Malna is a 3 year old crossbreed girl, she was dumped on the roadside along with her sister at about 2.5 months of age. She is medium size, weight: 15 kg, shoulder height: 44 cm.

Malna is a lovely girl, she is friendly and kind and loves everyone. She is energetic and playful and sociable around her doggie mates.

She enjoys nothing more than running around in the fields with other dogs, playing a chase. She cooperates nicely with humans too and is very kind with humans.

She enjoys car rides and is good around children too. She also walks nicely on the lead.

Malna would be best suited for a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and she is included in her family’s activities. She would be happiest in an active family, she would happily be your company on long walks, hikes and holidays.

Older dog savvy children will be considered.

Malna would probably be happiest living with another playful dog but she could also live happily as the only dog and the centre of attention in her home.

As all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Malna is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to Home Check and Adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Henry
description:
Meet Henry, a 4 year old male medium-sized Cross-Breed currently based in Basingstoke, UK. Born in May 2021, Henry has sadly been waiting since April 2022 to find his forever home, and honestly, it’s baffling because he is an absolute gem.

Henry is a lovely, friendly boy who adores people and truly enjoys companionship. He is great with other dogs and can also live happily with cats, making him a wonderfully versatile family companion.

Thanks to his gentle and sociable nature, he could also possibly live with children aged 10 years and over.

Henry is neutered and fully vaccinated and is more than ready to leave kennel life behind. He would love a home where he can finally settle, feel secure, and enjoy the love and attention he has been patiently waiting for.

An ideal home for Henry would be with a family or individual who can offer stability, affection, and regular walks. He has waited far too long for his chance and truly deserves a loving forever home to call his own.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Full rescue backup and support are provided throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Buddy
description:
Buddy is a 7 year old, neutered, fully vaccinated dog weighing approximately 20kg. He was rescued from a Romanian kill shelter in April 2023 and has since shown himself to be a curious and gentle companion with a moderate energy level.

Buddy is already housetrained and walks well on a lead.

Prior to coming to foster in the UK, Buddy was a curious dog, happy to greet strangers, but sadly his foster placement didn’t work out and now Buddy is struggling in kennels.

He is a gentle dog who needs equally gentle, kind adopters who are willing to rebuild his trust in people. In Romania he was good with the other dogs that he shared a kennel with.

Buddy needs help to adapt to living in a home. He’d be happy as the only dog or with calm, kind doggy companions. We are looking for a rural or semi-rural home because, once settled and able to trust again, Buddy will be happy to go on long walks.

He also needs a garden because he enjoys being outdoors. Ideally any adopters will have previous experience of Romanian dogs, and live within an hour or so of the kennels for several meets & greets.

However, transport can be arranged for the right adopters.

Please note Buddy does not have a tail. We are unsure if he was born like this or if something happened before he was rescued.

Full rescue backup and support throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Agika
description:
Agika is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a small cross-breed girl looking for her forever family.

This little girl has suffered so much in her short life; still, she is a little miracle. She was rescued from a heartbreaking situation where she had been kept on a short chain that had grown deep into her neck.

Once she was released, the chain had to be surgically removed.

Despite a truly rough start, Agika is a real sweetheart—loving, affectionate, and full of life. When she was rescued, she was timid and afraid of the world.

However, she soon left her old self behind, learned that some people can be trusted, and has grown into a joyful dog who loves life, loves other dogs, and now loves people too.

She walks nicely on the lead and looks forward to her walks, which she does not get many of.

She loves attention and will happily accept any amount of cuddles or affection. Agika is ready to start a new life in a safe, loving home where she will be treated the way she has always deserved.

She wants to be part of the family and discover all the things she has not yet had the chance to see or sniff.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred but is not essential, as all applications are assessed individually.

Agika is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her. She comes spayed and fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full rescue backup is provided.

name: Eddie and Billy
description:
Eddie is a no-age-given male Cross-Breed. He and his brother Billy are bonded brothers who are looking for a new home together. They are currently being fostered in Hertfordshire after the tragic loss of their owner.

The boys each weigh 12kg and have very friendly personalities. They love being around people and enjoy spending time with other dogs. Their affectionate nature makes them enjoyable companions.

Eddie has short hair, while Billy has a longer and fluffier coat. Both dogs enjoy their walks and love having the opportunity to run around and do zoomies. They would benefit from a home where they can continue to enjoy an active lifestyle.

They are looking for an active family, couple, or individual who can offer them a permanent and loving home. As bonded brothers, they would need to remain together so they can continue to enjoy each other’s company.

Their close relationship is an important part of their lives.

The boys are neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped. They are being cared for by The Little Rescue while they wait for the right adopters to come forward. A home check and adoption fee will apply as part of the adoption process.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross labrador retriever

name: Zelda
description:
Meet Zelda, a 2 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross Labrador Retriever — a brave and beautiful girl who has survived unimaginable cruelty yet still greets the world with love.

She came from hell. Zelda spent her early life chained so short she couldn’t even stand, the chain cutting deep into her neck. Despite such cruelty, she never lost her spark. Once freed, she greeted her rescuers with a wagging tail and a forgiving heart.

Now safe, she’s blossomed into an energetic, happy-natured girl. She’s medium-sized, affectionate, and adores people.

Zelda gets along well with other dogs — though she can be a bit boisterous in her play — and would thrive either as an only dog or with a friendly, tolerant companion.

In the kennel, she doesn’t get the exercise or freedom she craves, and she’s longing for a home where she can run, play, and finally just be a dog. She loves her walks, though she does pull on the lead, simply excited to be out exploring the world she missed for so long.

Zelda would suit an active home that can give her the exercise, structure, and affection she craves, so her joyful spirit can shine at long last. Older children will be considered.

Zelda has endured pain no animal should ever know. She deserves a life full of love, freedom, and fun.

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Shadow
description:
Lovely girl Shadow is a 2 year old medium sized mixed breed who has recently been saved by us from the streets.

She has a soft black and white short coat, and she is a very loving, affectionate and playful girl with her pal Max, who sleeps in her kennel.

Shadow is good with all the other dogs once introduced, but can be a bit of a slow burner to begin with, until she knows she is safe.

Shadow walks very well on her lead and we think that she is suitable for a family with older children with or without another friendly dog.

Shadow is not cat tested but we can do that if required.

Shadow is ready to travel now for the right family.

Great with people and dogs. gentle nature, and is obedient, loving and a pretty girl

name: Trixy
description:
Trixy is a 1.5-year-old, smaller medium crossbreed girl with a heart full of love. She was rescued from the streets alongside her mum (a Dachshund cross) and four siblings.

Three of the pups, including Trixy, are still waiting for their happy ending in a shelter in Hungary.

Trixy is a lively, playful young girl who sometimes shows a little shyness at first. But once she feels safe, her sweet, cuddly side shines through — she only needs love, patience, and kindness to truly thrive.

She adores playing with her doggie friends and gets along well with them.

She is friendly with people, including children, and enjoys her walks, trotting happily on the lead. Trixy would be happiest in a family where she isn’t left alone for long hours and is treated as a true member of the family — joining in on adventures, cuddles, and daily life.

She could easily share her home with another playful, gentle dog, or be the only pet, soaking up all the love and attention. Like all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, and commitment from her new family to settle and blossom into the wonderful companion she is meant to be.

Trixy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once her perfect family is found. She will come spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Cosmo
description:
Cosmo is a medium sized, mixed breed boy, around 1 year old.

Cosmo is currently in Cyprus and ready to travel.

Cosmo is growing up in the shelter and it’s not fair. He has been there since he was 6 months old and needs to get out asap so he can start living his life.

He arrived with his mum and siblings after they were confiscated from the owner.

Cosmo is a lovely, friendly boy and is patiently waiting for his chance at life. He should be enjoying life in a loving home, cared for and cherished, warm at night instead of sleeping in a concrete floor and looking at the same 4 walls of a kennel.

After some initial excitement, Cosmo is beginning to walk well on the leash. He is medium sized but strong so will need someone who can handle him. He’s great with other dogs, strangers, and children.

He’s far too young to spend his days in a shelter. He can live with a single person, a couple, or a family.

Cosmo is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and has been tested for infectious diseases. He is fully vaccinated and will be castrated.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

name: Meeka
description:
Meeka is a small sized (14kg), black and white female wadi dog who is currently in Oman. She was 1 year old in February 2026 and was rescued as a newborn puppy.

Her mum had been sadly shot and died so a local rescuer took in Meeka and her siblings and hand reared them. Meeka came into our care when she was 3 months old.

Meeka currently lives in a boarding facility and the volunteers walk and socialize with her every week. She is always very happy and excited to see them and enjoys going out for a walk.

She enjoys sniffing new smells, and having a dig in any mud she finds. She is wary of trucks and large vehicles that pass by though.

She gets along well with the other dogs in boarding, and although she has never lived with cats, she has shown no prey drive with the cats she has met.

She would love a home with people who have the time and energy for a young dog. She is healthy, fully vaccinated, microchipped, spayed and rabies titer tested so is ready to leave Oman now.

We will test her for Brucella before she leaves Oman.

name: Kormi
description:
Meet Kormi, a 7-year-old, 17 kg terrier-type boy with a scruffy black-and-white coat, a cute white chest, and the funniest little pointy ears! But it’s his big personality that really makes him stand out!

Kormi ended up at a public shelter due to poor living conditions, so it’s fair to say life hasn’t always been kind to him, and now he’s waiting behind bars for someone to give him the happy ending he deserves.

But this cheeky little chap is full of life, energy and character! He loves pottering about, keeping busy and, when he’s really excited, can even spin around on his back! He’s guaranteed to make you smile!
